english: Could you lend me the book?

chinese: 他做的事情你赞成的吧？
pinyin: tā zuò de shì qing nǐ zàn chéng de ba?
english: Do you approve of what he is doing?

pinyin: wèi? nǐ hái zài ma?
english: Hello? Are you still here?

pinyin: niǔ yuē shì de rén kǒu yǒu duō shao?
english: How large is the population of New York City?

pinyin: nǐ kàn dào nà tiáo hé le ma?
english: Have you seen that river?

pinyin: jiǎo shàng de shāng shì zěn me huí shì?
english: How did you get this injury on your foot?

pinyin: gěi wǒ nǐ de wèi zhi.
english: Give me your location.

chinese: 我们有个好极了的团队。
pinyin: wǒ men yǒu gè hǎo jí le de tuán duì.
english: We have a great team.

pinyin: wǒ xué xí dào běn yǔ hěn jiǔ le.
english: I've been studying Toki Pona for a long time.

chinese: 我是我们办公室的头儿。
pinyin: wǒ shì wǒ men bàn gōng shì de tóu r.
english: I am the boss in my office.

pinyin: nǐ chū xí le wǒ de hūn lǐ.
english: You were at my wedding.

pinyin: quán shì jiè de gè wèi, nǐ men hǎo!
english: "Hello, people of the world!"

pinyin: wǒ cuò guò pài duì le ma?
english: Did I miss the party?

pinyin: wǒ xū yào zuò shǒu shù ma?
english: Do I need surgery?

pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào shén me gèng zāo gāo.
english: I don't know what is worse.

pinyin: duì bu qǐ, wǒ bù néng dài hěn jiǔ.
english: I'm sorry, I can't stay long.

pinyin: wǒ men qù huá xuě zěn me yàng?
english: What do you say we go skiing?

pinyin: wǒ jué de hěn gū dú.
english: I feel lonely.

chinese: 能告诉我你的婚姻状况吗？
pinyin: néng gào su wǒ nǐ de hūn yīn zhuàng kuàng ma?
english: Can you tell me about your marital status?

pinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan shén me yàng de rén?
english: What kind of people do you like best?

pinyin: nǐ bǎ wǒ dāng shén me lā?
english: Who do you think I am?

pinyin: nǐ zhī dào kǒng jù de jià zhí ma?
english: Do you know the value of fear?

pinyin: tā shì ge diào yú zhuān jiā.
english: He is an expert at fishing.

chinese: 你的新电脑运行得好吗？
pinyin: nǐ de xīn diàn nǎo yùn xíng de hǎo ma?
english: Does your new computer run well?

pinyin: wǒ yǒu bù tóng chǐ cun de chuí zi.
english: I have hammers of different sizes.

chinese: 可以耽误你一点时间吗?
pinyin: kě yǐ dān wu nǐ yī diǎn shí jiān ma?
english: Do you have a minute?

english: This letter is wrongly addressed.

pinyin: wǒ men qù le lín zhōng sàn bù.
english: We went for a walk in the forest.

chinese: 没有人比我更渴望這個了。
pinyin: méi yǒu rén bǐ wǒ gèng kě wàng zhè ge le.
english: No one wants this more than I do.

pinyin: kuài zhōng chǎng xiū xi le.
english: It's almost intermission.

pinyin: wǒ zài yě rěn shòu bu liǎo tā le!
english: I can't bear to deal with her anymore.

chinese: 站在窗口的是你們的老闆嗎？
pinyin: zhàn zài chuāng kǒu de shì nǐ men de lǎo bǎn ma?
english: Is that your boss by the window?

pinyin: nǐ zài nà li dài le duō jiǔ?
english: How long did you stay?

pinyin: wǒ men zhī jiān wán le, bǎ jiè zhi huán gěi wǒ!
english: It's over between us. Give me back my ring!

pinyin: hēi, kàn wǒ zhǎo dào le shén me.
english: Hey, look what I found.

chinese: 你确认那是可纠正的错误吗？
pinyin: nǐ què rèn nà shì kě jiū zhèng de cuò wù ma?
english: Can you confirm that it is a correctable error?

chinese: 你是说是我杀了汤姆吗？
pinyin: nǐ shì shuō shì wǒ shā le tāng mǔ ma?
english: Are you saying that I killed Tom?

chinese: 老师给我们布置了家庭作业。
pinyin: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men bù zhì le jiā tíng zuò yè.
english: The teacher gave us homework.

pinyin: yǒu rén tōu le wǒ de bāo.
english: My bag was stolen.

chinese: 他是一个脑子灵活的人。
pinyin: tā shì yī gè nǎo zi líng huó de rén.
english: He is a quick-witted man.

pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ shuō shí huà.
english: I know you've been telling the truth.

chinese: 今天晚上你在什么地方有约会？
pinyin: jīn tiān wǎn shang nǐ zài shén me dì fang yǒu yuē huì?
english: Where's your date tonight?

chinese: 你期望在這兒能找到甚麼呢？
pinyin: nǐ qī wàng zài zhè r néng zhǎo dào shén me ne?
english: What do you hope to find here?

pinyin: nǐ xiǎng àn shì shén me?
english: What are you getting at?

pinyin: wǒ gāi dài xiē shén me?
english: What should I bring?

pinyin: wǒ yào gào su nǐ zhēn xiàng.
english: I'm going to tell you the truth.

pinyin: nǐ gāi zǎo yī diǎn lái de.
english: You should've come a little earlier.

pinyin: nǐ qīn zì qù ma!
english: Go there yourself.

chinese: 你见到的是两兄弟中的哪一个？
pinyin: nǐ jiàn dào de shì liǎng xiōng dì zhōng de nǎ yī ge?
english: Which one of the two brothers did you see?

chinese: 许多房屋被洪水冲走了。
pinyin: xǔ duō fáng wū bèi hóng shuǐ chōng zǒu le.
english: A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.

pinyin: wǒ néng shā nǐ.
english: I could kill you.

chinese: 我的钢笔不像你那支那么好。
pinyin: wǒ de gāng bǐ bù xiàng nǐ nà zhī nà me hǎo.
english: My pen isn't as good as yours.

pinyin: nà shi zhù zài gé bì de nán rén.
english: That's the man who lives next door.

pinyin: wǒ de qián bāo bèi rén tōu le.
english: My wallet has been stolen.

chinese: 要怎么才能把他拉下马？
pinyin: yào zěn me cái néng bǎ tā lā xià mǎ?
english: What will it take to bring him down?

chinese: 说到田中先生，你最近见过他吗？
pinyin: shuō dào tián zhōng xiān sheng, nǐ zuì jìn jiàn guo tā ma?
english: Talking of Mr Tanaka, have you seen him lately?

chinese: 我对他的坚持感到很惊讶。
pinyin: wǒ duì tā de jiān chí gǎn dào hěn jīng yà.
english: I was surprised by his perseverance.

pinyin: tā shì gè mí rén de nǚ hái zi.
english: She's a glamorous girl.

chinese: 给我说说你去过的一些地方。
pinyin: gěi wǒ shuō shuo nǐ qù guo de yī xiē dì fang.
english: Tell me about some of the places you've visited.

pinyin: wǒ de qī zi zài shì tú shuì jiào.
english: My wife's trying to sleep.

pinyin: tā yào shi chéng le, wǒ gēn nǐ xìng.
english: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.

pinyin: dào zhè suǒ dà xué yǒu duō yuǎn?
english: How far is it to this university?

chinese: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。
pinyin: xiāo fáng chē dào dá zhī qián, fáng zi jiù quán shāo le.
english: The house burned to the ground before the fire truck arrived.

pinyin: tā de wèi kǒu hěn hǎo.
english: He has a good appetite.

pinyin: bà ba jīn tiān hěn bù nài fán.
english: Dad's in an impatient mood today.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi jué cè de rén.
english: I want to be the one who decides.

chinese: 得了！你弄得她不自在了！
pinyin: dé le! nǐ nòng de tā bù zì zai le!
english: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!

pinyin: wǒ yǒu hǎo jǐ dá ne.
english: I have several dozens of them.

pinyin: tā chū mài le wǒ.
english: He betrayed me.

pinyin: nǐ cān jiā shè tuán huó dòng ma?
english: Do you take part in any community activities?

pinyin: nǐ rèn wéi wǒ fēng le ma?
english: Do you think I'm crazy?

pinyin: nà shì zhuàng gāo lóu, bù shì ma?
english: That is a high building, is it not?

chinese: 我可以和你一起呆在这里吗？
pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ hé nǐ yī qǐ dāi zài zhè li ma?
english: Can I stay here with you?

pinyin: tā shì zěn me fǔ yǎng hái zi de?
english: How does she bring up her children?

pinyin: wǒ bù xiāng xìn tā shì zhēn xīn de.
english: I don't think he is sincere.

chinese: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。
pinyin: wǒ jiàn yì nǐ yǒng yuǎn bù yào rù bù fū chū.
english: I advise you never to live beyond your income.

chinese: 你认为我把自己当傻瓜？
pinyin: nǐ rèn wéi wǒ bǎ zì jǐ dāng shǎ guā?
english: Do you think I think of myself as an idiot?

chinese: 朋友們再也不和我說話了。
pinyin: péng you men zài yě bù hé wǒ shuō huà le.
english: My friends won't talk to me anymore.

chinese: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
pinyin: yuè qiú shì dì qiú wéi yī de wèi xīng.
english: The moon is the earth's only satellite.

pinyin: hé wǒ men liú zài yī qǐ ba!
english: Stay with us.

pinyin: nǐ hé tāng mǔ dǎ jià le?
english: Have you and Tom been fighting?

chinese: 问题是我们如何应付目前的困难。
pinyin: wèn tí shì wǒ men rú hé yìng fu mù qián de kùn nan.
english: The problem is how we cope with the present difficulties.

chinese: 如果你找到他，请打给我。
pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ zhǎo dào tā, qǐng dǎ gěi wǒ.
english: Call me if you find him.

pinyin: nà bù shì wǒ de běn yì.
english: That wasn't my intent.

pinyin: zhè ge wǒ zhǐ hé nǐ shuō o.
english: I'm telling you this confidentially.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yī qǐ qù.
english: I want to go with you.

pinyin: wǒ měi tiān gōng zuò bù tóng shí duàn.
english: Every day I work different hours.

chinese: 你读给我听的时候，我就可以做缝纫了。
pinyin: nǐ dú gěi wǒ tīng de shí hou, wǒ jiù kě yǐ zuò féng rèn le.
english: While you are reading to me, I can do my sewing.

chinese: 警察会让你去找子弹的。
pinyin: jǐng chá huì ràng nǐ qù zhǎo zǐ dàn de.
english: The police will get you to find the bullets.

chinese: 你想和我一起吃午餐嗎？
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng hé wǒ yī qǐ chī wǔ cān ma?
english: Would you like to eat lunch with me?

pinyin: nǐ yǒu chú xiù de dōng xi ma?
english: Do you have anything to remove stains?

chinese: 我对外籍员工没有偏见。
pinyin: wǒ duì wài jí yuán gōng méi yǒu piān jiàn.
english: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.

chinese: 我记下了他的名字和地址。
pinyin: wǒ jì xià le tā de míng zi hé dì zhǐ.
english: I memorized his name and address.

pinyin: tā yí kāi, ràng kǎ chē tōng guò.
english: He pulled aside to let a truck pass.

pinyin: nǐ qiàn wǒ yī gè wěn.
english: You owe me a kiss.

pinyin: wǒ bù shì bèn dàn.
english: I'm not stupid.

pinyin: wǒ cuī huǐ le suǒ yǒu de zhèng jù.
english: I destroyed all the evidence.

pinyin: tā bǎ wǒ de wán xiào dàng zhēn le.
english: She took my joke seriously.

pinyin: nǐ zài shuō shén me guǐ huà?
english: What the hell are you talking about?
